name: get_self
description: Own status: pos, dimension, biome, facing, game mode, hp/food/air/xp, effects, held items (durability, enchantments, potion), armor, inventory, task, session, reflexes, time.

name: get_surroundings
description: Nearby summary: ground, light, terrain, biome directions, time, weather, notable blocks with owner (incl. written signs), item frames, mobs per species (nearest id), vehicles, dropped items.

name: inspect_area
description: Read a box of blocks in the current dimension: per-block pos, state, owner (and sign text), or a summary of block counts. Unloaded cells are marked.

mode.description: auto: per-block when small or filtered

name: find_blocks
description: Find the nearest blocks of given types in loaded chunks, with owner.

type.description: Block id or group (log, bed, door, stairs, slab, fence, trapdoor, plank, wool, crop, sapling, iron_ore incl. deepslate); comma-separate up to 8

name: get_players
description: Other players in tracking range: pos, direction, held item, armor, recent activity (guessed).

name: get_chat
description: Recent public chat, verbatim (private messages never appear).

name: get_task
description: Current background task and its progress.

name: wait_events
description: Wait for game events (long poll). task_only=true returns as soon as the current task ends; progress events do not wake it.

name: say
description: Say something in game chat ([AI] prefix is added). Must not start with /. Rate-limited.

text.description: Message, in the language the players use

name: memory_read
description: Read this world's memory (goals, places, notes).

name: memory_write
description: Write one memory entry; the same key overwrites. Value up to 500 chars, total up to 16 KB.

name: memory_delete
description: Delete one memory entry.

name: plan
description: Your current plan (kept by the mod; a fresh result from request_plan replaces it). Task results and idle reminders show the current step as plan_step=n/m. show (default); done = the current step is complete, move to the next; set = write your own plan (replaces it); clear.

steps.description: For set: 1 to 8 steps in order, one per line

name: list_reflexes
description: List reflexes and whether each is on.

name: set_reflex
description: Turn one reflex on or off (all reset to on in a new session).

name: stop
description: Stop the current background task.

name: set_status
description: Set the one sentence the user sees on the HUD under the task line: what you are doing and why, in the user's language. It stays until you set another; empty clears.

name: goto
description: Walk to a position without breaking blocks (still jumps/places to climb). Omit y to match x,z only and follow the surface.

name: goto_block
description: Walk next to the nearest block of a type without breaking blocks.

name: look_at
description: Turn to look at a position.

name: break_block
description: Break one block within reach (usually a few seconds). Optional tool_match selects a specific tool by enchantment/durability (e.g. silk_touch, fortune).

tool_match.description: Optional tool filter: silk_touch, fortune, efficiency:3, best_dur...

name: place_block
description: Place a block item at a position within reach, next to a solid face; waits for server confirmation. facing sets the placed block's facing (stairs, furnace, chest, hopper, wall torch, observer...; logs use its axis); half sets top/bottom for slabs, stairs and trapdoors; sneak=true holds shift to place against interactive blocks (chest, furnace, crafting table...). Results are verified.

facing.description: Facing of the placed block; omit for the default

half.description: Half for slabs, stairs and trapdoors

sneak.description: Hold shift to place against interactive/block-entity neighbors

name: use_block
description: Right-click a block within reach: doors, switches, containers, or read a book on a lectern; reports open/powered/lit or book contents when applicable.

name: equip
description: Equip an item to the main hand, off hand, or an armor slot; pass item="none" with slot=offhand|head|chest|legs|feet to unequip back to the main inventory.

match.description: Attribute filter: ench=, stored=, potion=, name=, best_dur, low_dur, or shorthand

name: eat
description: Eat food or drink a consumable (potion, milk_bucket, honey_bottle). Omit item to pick the best safe food.

name: attack
description: Hit a mob once within reach (entity id, or type = nearest within 16). Players, pets and villagers are protected. To fight until it dies, use hunt.

name: hunt
description: Track a mob, kill it and pick up keepable drops. Same tactics as the self_defense reflex (hit-and-back on creepers, shield toward ranged mobs, bow at range if you have bow and arrows).

target.description: Entity id or type (nearest within 48), e.g. sheep

name: drop
description: Drop items from the inventory (incl. offhand), optionally facing a position or filtered by match.

match.description: Attribute filter: ench=, stored=, potion=, name=, best_dur, low_dur, or shorthand

name: creative_take
description: Creative mode only: take items from the creative inventory into your inventory.

name: clear_area
description: Walk over and clear natural blocks of given types in a box, like a normal player. Only cells loaded and matching at start are handled.

block.description: Block id or group (e.g. birch_leaves, leaves); comma-separate up to 8, e.g. dirt,stone

name: mine
description: Find exposed/reachable blocks, walk there, mine and pick them up until count is reached. Only breaks target blocks and soft plants/leaves (never tunnels through solid stone/dirt; use dig_tunnel to reach buried ores). Checks tool and inventory space first. Optional tool_match enforces a matching tool on target blocks.

block.description: Block id or group: log, stone, coal_ore, iron_ore (incl. deepslate)...

search.description: If not enough are loaded, explore outward (up to 5 min)

tool_match.description: Optional tool filter for target blocks: fortune, silk_touch, best_dur...

name: dig_tunnel
description: Dig a stepped 1x3 downward staircase (stairs_down), 1x3 upward staircase (stairs_up), or 1x2 flat tunnel (flat) step by step. Checks ahead for lava, water, drops, protected blocks and optional stop_on ores before swinging, places torches every torch_every steps (torch_every=0 is limited to 12 steps), and reports all ores exposed along the tunnel.

target_y.description: Stop at this y (stairs_down or stairs_up only)

torch_every.description: Auto-place torch every N steps in darkness (0=unlit, max 12 steps)

stop_on.description: Comma-separated ore ids/groups to stop before breaking (e.g. diamond_ore, any_ore)

tool_match.description: Optional tool filter for digging the tunnel

name: craft
description: Craft items. Prefers a reachable or owned crafting table; can place one nearby from inventory materials. Missing materials are reported up front; it never gathers.

name: smelt
description: Smelt in a furnace, blast_furnace or smoker within 32 blocks (prefers blast_furnace/smoker when supported, or places a furnace from inventory), or inspect/collect a furnace with action=list|take at x,y,z.

action.description: smelt (default), list (inspect furnace), or take (collect output)

item.description: Input (e.g. raw_iron) or wanted output (e.g. iron_ingot); required for smelt

name: build_wall
description: Build a straight wall between two points (same x or same z), height blocks up from the lower point. Fills empty cells only; never breaks anything. dry_run=true previews (also while paused).

name: build_house
description: Build a livable house (walls, windows, flat roof, door; keeps natural ground by default and fills only dips, pass floor to pave) fitted to the terrain; refuses if the ground varies more than 3. Saved as a blueprint: the id is in the result, resume with build_blueprint. Pass id to regenerate it with changed params. Touches only natural blocks and its own blocks. dry_run=true previews.

from.description: Outer wall corner "x,y,z"; y = interior standing level (floor sits at y-1)

floor.description: Optional floor block to pave the whole floor; omitted keeps natural ground and fills only dips with material

door.description: Wooden door id, or none for an opening; omitted: use a wooden door from inventory if any

window.description: e.g. glass_pane; one per wall except the door wall

id.description: Regenerate this house; give only the params to change

name: build_blueprint
description: Save, build, show, modify or demolish multi-block blueprints. Building only touches natural blocks and blocks this blueprint placed. Kept after missing materials; resume by id. For a plain house use build_house.

action.description: create: save and build. resume: continue by id. list. show: parts and site diff. update: parts replaces all or add_parts appends, then builds; own blocks no longer in the design are removed. demolish: remove own blocks matching it, then delete the record. delete: forget the record only.

id.description: Blueprint id (resume, show, update, demolish, delete)

parts.description: Whole design (create, update); later parts override earlier ones

to.description: Relative opposite corner, inclusive; omit for one block

block.description: Block with optional state, e.g. oak_stairs[facing=north]; air = keep empty

add_parts.description: Parts appended to the saved design (update)

to.description: Relative opposite corner, inclusive; omit for one block

block.description: Block with optional state, e.g. oak_stairs[facing=north]; air = keep empty

dry_run.description: Preview create, update or resume without changing anything

offset.description: Page start for list, show, dry_run

name: till_and_plant
description: Till natural dirt or grass and plant seeds. Use ground-level y. Leave an empty adjacent cell over soil for melons/pumpkins to grow.

name: harvest
description: Harvest ripe crops you planted and fruits linked to your melon or pumpkin stems. Keeps the stems for regrowth.

name: sleep
description: Walk to a bed and sleep; night or thunderstorm only. Omit x,y,z to use the nearest free bed within 32 blocks (anyone's).

name: follow
description: Follow a player at a distance until time is up, they vanish, stop, or pause. Only when you decide to.

name: use_on_entity
description: Walk to a mob and right-click it holding an item: shear, breed, leash, milk... Omit item for an empty hand. State-changing use on players and tamed pets (anyone's, yours too) is blocked; villagers and wandering traders cannot be used at all (no trading).

target.description: Entity id or type, e.g. sheep

name: mount
description: Walk to and ride a boat, minecart or similar. The driver steers; you never drive. Dismount before walking. Tamed horses (anyone's, yours too), villagers and wandering traders are blocked.

target.description: Entity id or type, e.g. oak_boat

name: dismount
description: Get off a boat, minecart or similar (usually under 1 s).

name: use_item
description: Use an item (incl. offhand): on the block at x,y,z within reach (fill/pour bucket, flint_and_steel, bone_meal), or without x,y,z in the air — or read written_book/writable_book text directly without opening the book GUI.

item.description: e.g. water_bucket, bucket, flint_and_steel, bone_meal, written_book

match.description: Attribute filter: ench=, stored=, potion=, name=, best_dur, low_dur, or shorthand

page.description: Start page (1-based) when reading a book without x,y,z

name: fish
description: Fish at water within 16 blocks until count catches or time is up. Needs a fishing rod.

name: chest
description: Walk to a chest, barrel, shulker box or ender chest and list its contents, put items in (incl. offhand), or take items out. items keys accept item_id or item_id[filter] (e.g. potion[fire_resistance]). Anyone's chests and naturally generated ones are allowed. The result lists the contents.

items.description: {item_id or item_id[filter]: count}; required for put and take

name: enchant
description: Use an enchanting table within 32 blocks (prefers own; omit x,y,z to auto-find). action=preview reads the 3 offers, clues and max_level (to verify 15 bookshelves = 30) and returns the item to inventory; action=apply spends lapis_lazuli and levels on option 1, 2 or 3.

name: anvil
description: Use an anvil within 32 blocks (prefers own; anyone's anvil allowed; omit x,y,z to auto-find). action=preview reports result, level cost and too_expensive; action=apply combines items/books, repairs or renames (incl. name_tag).

second_item.description: Optional right slot item id (book, tool, repair material)

rename.description: Optional new name (max 50 chars); at least second_item or rename is required

name: grindstone
description: Use a grindstone within 32 blocks (prefers own; omit x,y,z to auto-find) to disenchant an item for XP or combine-repair two identical items while removing non-curse enchantments.

second_item.description: Optional second identical item id to combine-repair
